title: pm-dispatch twins: `carrier:` names a card number or a person; the `--body` intercept list names the vacant-ledger refusal
body:
Fixes #23423

Clause-②: no

Two single-line, in-place edits that bring the two "twin" rule lines PR #23417 could not touch into line with the handover rule already on `main` (#23396's ruling A, landed by PR #23417 as `filing-gate.md`'s 「搭下个碰 X 的 PR」不算 `carrier:` sentence, `post-stamped.mjs --body`'s vacant-ledger refusal and `check-handover.mjs`). File surface: exactly the two lines the card names. #23431 (`filing-gate.md`), #23445 (`SKILL.md`) and #23420 are not addressed here and remain open; `scripts/**`, `AGENTS.md` and every other reference are untouched. Based on `main` at `2659901c5e`; both anchor lines were re-read there before editing (unchanged since `823da2f21c`).

## Before → after

### `.claude/agents/os-dev.md:53` — sub-bullet of rule 2's 不立卡 list

Before (116 bytes):

```text
   - `carrier:` = 将碰该文件的 PR 或人,答不出写「承接者:无」;皆无 ⇒ 只进 Acceptance notes。
```

After (120 bytes):

```text
   - `carrier:` = 卡号或人,⛔ 非下个碰 X 的 PR;无则「承接者:无」;皆无 ⇒ 只进 Acceptance notes。
```

- `carrier:` now names a card number or a person, never the PR that will touch the file; the negated phrase is `filing-gate.md`'s own 「下个碰 X 的 PR」.
- 「承接者:无」 stays the honest answer when there is none (无则 — the ruling's "when there is none"); 「皆无 ⇒ 只进 Acceptance notes」 is unchanged, so "none" still means Acceptance notes only.
- The `carrier:` key spelling (the PM's recognisers read it in reports) and the sub-bullet indentation are unchanged; no other line of the file moves. Lines 400 → 400 (ceiling 402).

### `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/seat-post-protocol.md:29` — the write-side refresh rule

Before (116 bytes):

```text
- 刷新前回执未读敲门;`post-stamped.mjs --body` 拦截:评论晚于正文末次戳 ⇒ `--ack-through=ID`。
```

After (120 bytes):

```text
- 刷新前回执敲门;`--body` 拦截:评论晚于末次戳 ⇒ `--ack-through=ID`;空座欠账无卡号 ⇒ 拒写。
```

- The intercept list now names both things `post-stamped.mjs --body` refuses before the transport: a comment later than the body's last stamp (remedy `--ack-through=ID`, unchanged) and the refusal PR #23417 added — a VACANT seat body (`⏳ vacant` first in its Current PM section) whose ledger obligation lines carry no card reference, refused as `[vacant-ledger]` with `EXIT_REFUSED` (2) and "Nothing was written" — hence 拒写.
- 空座 / 欠账 / 卡号 are the words the checklist's own steps 4–6 (「台账义务逐条带卡号」, 「空座正文」) and the refusal's keyed vocabulary (`欠`, "the filing gate's own word for a duty") already use; nothing is invented.
- Paid for inside the line: `scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs` is named on L28 directly above, so `--body` keeps its referent; 未读 is implied by 回执 and restated by the first trigger; 正文 is implied by `--body`. Lines 91 → 91 (ceiling 91).

## Changeset

`.claude/**` ships in no package (no published package's `files[]` lists it), so `skip-changeset` applies; it is applied through `node scripts/pm/label-write.mjs --issue PRN --add skip-changeset` once this PR exists.

## Acceptance notes

Observations only; none is a card (no reproducible defect, no contract violation, no authoring trap), each 承接者:无 — so Acceptance notes only:

- The card body cites `filing-gate.md` L20 for the 「搭下个碰 X 的 PR」 sentence; on `main` at `2659901c5e` it stands at L22 (the file grew by two lines after the card was written). Line drift in card text, not a defect.
- `post-stamped.mjs`'s `LEDGER_CARD_REF` accepts any `#N`, so a PR number on an obligation line passes the vacant-ledger refusal mechanically; the file's own header states this ("the ruling's grain is the LINE … a reviewer's half"). A declared boundary, not a gap; the new L53 wording puts the distinction (卡号, not the PR) where the author reads it.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs --ran` wants `command :: exit N` lines to derive its NOT-MEASURED count, and says so only after a bare-line record is handed to it; `--commands` does not mention the form. Polish, not a card.
- `check:doc-formula-expressions` is derived for a `.claude/**`-only diff and needs two package builds (1m39s under the lock) to judge docs this diff never touched. Derivation breadth, noted for whoever next tunes the family's population; not a card.

## 维护者速读(草稿)

**改了什么**:两行原地改写,文件面只有这两行。① `os-dev.md:53`:`carrier:` 从「将碰该文件的 PR 或人」改为「卡号或人,⛔ 非下个碰 X 的 PR」;「承接者:无」与「皆无 ⇒ 只进 Acceptance notes」保留。② `seat-post-protocol.md:29`:`--body` 拦截清单在「评论晚于末次戳 ⇒ `--ack-through=ID`」旁加上「空座欠账无卡号 ⇒ 拒写」。两文件行数不变(400、91),两行均 120 字节,恰在上限。

**为什么改**:#23396 裁决 A(交接台账每条义务带卡号;「搭下个碰 X 的 PR」不是承接者;`post-stamped --body` 拒写无卡号的空座台账)已由 PR #23417 落到 `filing-gate.md`、`post-stamped.mjs`、`check-handover.mjs`;这两行在那张 PR 的文件面之外,仍说着旧规则。dev 读 `os-dev.md` 决定 `carrier:` 怎么填,席位读 `seat-post-protocol.md` 决定刷新前查什么——两处旧文会把人引向门禁会拒的写法。

**风险与代价(含回滚)**:纯规则文本,无运行时、无发布面。代价在措辞:为守 120 字节,L29 删了「未读」「正文」与工具名(上一行已点名 `post-stamped.mjs`),L53 删了「写」字。回滚 = revert 本 PR 的单个 commit。`.claude/**` 为 Tier S,由席位达档复核后入队落地。

**席位意见**:

**你要做的**:无需动作;本 PR 走 Tier S 席内复核与队列。
